prompt: A side-on cutaway from a colony-management video game: every room a lit box like an ant farm, chunky stylised 3D figures with big heads and stubby limbs, bright toy colours on matte surfaces. A tall narrow city building cut open in cross-section like a doll's house after dark, four floors only, seen from across the street, low and to the left, so the building stands off-centre and the street runs out of frame. Attic: an old woman in a coat shivers by one candle in an ice blue room. Street level: a brick red bakery; a red crowd and a blue crowd of mixed ages and skin tones shove each other under a yellow street lamp, the roof of a police vehicle in the near left corner. Basement: in emerald lamplight, printing presses throw banknotes into the air while gangsters in pinstripe suits play music and a tall skinny mayor in a bowler hat and gold chain dances. Bottom: an orange furnace. Soot, peeling paint and puddles. Thanks.
